subtitle.zh: 本隱私政策說明我們如何收集、使用和保護您的個人信息。
subtitle.en: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal information.

paragraphs.zh: 為了提供更好的服務和維護平台安全，我們會收集以下信息：
paragraphs.en: To provide better services and maintain platform security, we collect the following information:

paragraphs.zh: 會話時間：用於分析用戶活躍度和改善服務質量
paragraphs.en: Session time: Used to analyze user activity and improve service quality

paragraphs.zh: IP 地址：用於安全監控和防止濫用行為
paragraphs.en: IP address: Used for security monitoring and preventing abuse

paragraphs.zh: 瀏覽器信息：用於優化網站兼容性和用戶體驗
paragraphs.en: Browser information: Used to optimize website compatibility and user experience

paragraphs.zh: 收集這些信息的目的是為了：
paragraphs.en: The purpose of collecting this information is to:

paragraphs.zh: • 維護平台安全，防止惡意攻擊和濫用
paragraphs.en: • Maintain platform security and prevent malicious attacks and abuse

paragraphs.zh: • 分析用戶行為，改善服務質量
paragraphs.en: • Analyze user behavior to improve service quality

paragraphs.zh: • 提供技術支援和故障排除
paragraphs.en: • Provide technical support and troubleshooting

paragraphs.zh: • 遵守法律法規要求
paragraphs.en: • Comply with legal and regulatory requirements

paragraphs.zh: 我們採用多重安全措施保護您的數據：
paragraphs.en: We employ multiple security measures to protect your data:

paragraphs.zh: • 使用 HTTPS 加密傳輸所有數據
paragraphs.en: • Use HTTPS encryption for all data transmission

paragraphs.zh: • 實施嚴格的訪問控制和權限管理
paragraphs.en: • Implement strict access control and permission management

paragraphs.zh: • 24/7 安全監控和異常檢測
paragraphs.en: • 24/7 security monitoring and anomaly detection

paragraphs.zh: • 定期更新安全措施和系統補丁
paragraphs.en: • Regular security updates and system patches

paragraphs.zh: 我們高度重視用戶的匿名性：
paragraphs.en: We highly value user anonymity:

paragraphs.zh: 評論者的身份資訊將被嚴格保密
paragraphs.en: Commenter identity information will be kept strictly confidential

paragraphs.zh: 我們承諾不會向任何個人、組織或第三方披露用戶的真實身份
paragraphs.en: We promise not to disclose user real identities to any individuals, organizations, or third parties

paragraphs.zh: 只有授權的技術人員在必要時才能訪問用戶數據，且僅用於技術維護
paragraphs.en: Only authorized technical personnel can access user data when necessary, and only for technical maintenance

paragraphs.zh: 除非法律明確要求，否則我們不會主動披露用戶資訊
paragraphs.en: Unless explicitly required by law, we will not proactively disclose user information

paragraphs.zh: 我們的數據保留政策如下：
paragraphs.en: Our data retention policy is as follows:

paragraphs.zh: • 會話數據：保留 30 天後自動刪除
paragraphs.en: • Session data: Automatically deleted after 30 days

paragraphs.zh: • 日誌數據：保留 90 天用於安全分析
paragraphs.en: • Log data: Retained for 90 days for security analysis

paragraphs.zh: • 用戶內容：根據用戶要求可隨時刪除
paragraphs.en: • User content: Can be deleted at any time upon user request

paragraphs.zh: 我們使用 Cookie 來改善您的瀏覽體驗。詳細資訊請參閱我們的 Cookie 政策。
paragraphs.en: We use cookies to improve your browsing experience. For detailed information, please refer to our Cookie Policy.

paragraphs.zh: 您擁有以下權利：
paragraphs.en: You have the following rights:

paragraphs.zh: • 查詢我們收集的關於您的資訊
paragraphs.en: • Query information we have collected about you

paragraphs.zh: • 要求更正不準確的個人資訊
paragraphs.en: • Request correction of inaccurate personal information

paragraphs.zh: • 要求刪除您的個人資料
paragraphs.en: • Request deletion of your personal data

paragraphs.zh: • 要求匯出您的資料
paragraphs.en: • Request export of your data

paragraphs.zh: 我們可能會不時更新此隱私政策。重大變更將通過網站通知公告。
paragraphs.en: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Major changes will be announced through website notifications.

paragraphs.zh: 如果您對此隱私政策有任何疑問或需要行使您的權利，請通過網站聯繫功能與我們聯繫。
paragraphs.en: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or need to exercise your rights, please contact us through the website contact feature.

paragraphs.zh: 本平台受 reCAPTCHA 保護，並適用 Google 隱私政策及服務條款。
paragraphs.en: This platform is protected by reCAPTCHA and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.
